title: ScreenSearch: Uncertainty-Aware OS Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2605.16024v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Desktop GUI agents operate under partial observability: visually similar screens can correspond to different underlying workflow states, so locally plausible actions can lead to sharply different outcomes. We frame this as a problem of computer/OS state exploration, where effective behavior requires both expanding the reachable frontier and reducing ambiguity before committing. We present ScreenSearch, a system that combines structural screen retrieval and deduplication with an ambiguity-aware PUCT graph-bandit for large-scale desktop exploration. The retrieval layer converts UIA trees into location-aware structural features, indexes related screens through sparse token search and metadata filters, and maintains a shared deduplicated state graph across VM workers. translated_title: ScreenSearch：不确定性感知的操作系统探索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.16024v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：桌面GUI代理在部分可观测性下运行：视觉上相似的屏幕可能对应不同的底层工作流状态，因此局部合理的动作可能导致截然不同的结果。我们将其视为计算机/操作系统状态探索问题，其中有效行为既需要扩展可达边界，又需要在提交前减少歧义。我们提出ScreenSearch，一个结合结构化屏幕检索与去重以及歧义感知PUCT图-波段算法的系统，用于大规模桌面探索。检索层将UIA树转换为位置感知的结构化特征，通过稀疏令牌搜索和元数据过滤器索引相关屏幕，并在多个虚拟机工作器之间维护共享的去重状态图。在此图之上，我们基于匹配动作的结果分散定义了一个可扩展的歧义信号。如果相似屏幕在同一动作下产生不同的下一状态，则该信号会标记潜在的歧义。
tldr: ScreenSearch通过结合结构化屏幕检索和歧义感知图-波段算法，解决了桌面GUI代理在部分可观测性下的状态探索问题，从而在提交动作前有效减少歧义并扩展可达状态空间。
en_tdlr: ScreenSearch addresses partial observability in desktop GUI agents by combining structural screen retrieval with an ambiguity-aware graph-bandit algorithm, effectively reducing ambiguity and expanding reachable states before committing actions.
